clips.title: The story
paras: Nefarian's severed head is carried from Blackrock Mountain to Orgrimmar as proof of victory. Presented to Warchief Thrall, it marks the fall of a great enemy of the Horde.

Nefarian has fallen at last. He masterminded Blackwing Lair and led the black dragon brood in the Eastern Kingdoms. His colossal, battle-scarred head proves his death. For Horde warriors, carrying the prize from the burning heights of Blackrock Mountain across the Great Sea to Durotar brings great honor.

The trophy is brought before Warchief Thrall. He knows the corruption of Blackrock Mountain well. He freed his people from the internment camps and led them away from the old Horde's demonic bloodlust. The son of Deathwing has fallen, and the Blackrock orcs are free of the dark dragon's cruel dominion.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The old feeling returns. The welcome pangs of victory reverberate throughout your being. Before you lies the monolithic, battle scarred head of Nefarian. Return it to your Warchief, champion.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I wish that I could have been there to see the look on the face of the beast as you struck the killing blow, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have honored the Horde once more, friend. The son of Deathwing lays dead. Surely, the evil one stirs.
